14606-and-thus-he-came-a-christmas-fanta.description: A book by Cyrus Townsend Brady. it were, poised in the air, the dancers stood amazed. One looked to another in surprise. Something stole throughout the room which was neither music, nor lights, nor fragrance, but which was life--a presence!

arxiv-1808-00529.title: Open Category Detection with PAC Guarantees
arxiv-1808-00529.creator: Si Liu, Risheek Garrepalli, Thomas G. Dietterich, Alan Fern, Dan Hendrycks
arxiv-1808-00529.description: Abstract Open category detection is the problem of detecting “alien” test instances that belong to categories or classes that were not present in the training data. In many applications, reliably detecting such aliens is central to ensuring the safety and accuracy of test set predictions.

arxiv-2104-13709.title: Heegaard Floer homology and plane curves with non-cuspidal singularities
arxiv-2104-13709.creator: Maciej Borodzik, Beibei Liu, Ian Zemke
arxiv-2104-13709.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Maciej Borodzik, Beibei Liu, Ian Zemke. We study possible configurations of singular points occuring on general algebraic curves in ℂ ​ P 2 \mathbb{C}P^{2} via Floer theory. To achieve this, we describe a general formula for the H 1 H_{1} -action on the knot Floer complex of the knotification of a link in S 3 S^{3} , in terms of natural actions on the link Floer complex of the original link. This result may be of interest on its own.

arxiv-2211-02579.title: V2X Misbehavior in Maneuver Sharing and Coordination Service: Considerations for Standardization
arxiv-2211-02579.creator: Jean-Philippe Monteuuis, Jonathan Petit, Mohammad Raashid Ansari, Cong Chen, Seung Yang
arxiv-2211-02579.description: Abstract Connected and Automated Vehicles (CAV) use sensors and wireless communication to improve road safety and efficiency. However, attackers may target Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication. Indeed, an attacker may send authenticated-but-wrong data to send false location information, alert incorrect events, or report a bogus object endangering other CAVs’ safety.

arxiv-2310-17854.title: The Non-zonal Rossby-Haurwitz Solutions of the 2D Euler Equations on a Rotating Ellipsoid
arxiv-2310-17854.creator: Chenghao Xu
arxiv-2310-17854.description: Abstract In this article, we investigate the incompressible 2D Euler equations on a rotating biaxial ellipsoid, which model the dynamics of the atmosphere of a Jovian planet. We study the non-zonal Rossby-Haurwitz solutions of the Euler equations on an ellipsoid, while previous works only considered the case of a sphere.

arxiv-2403-09054.title: Muhammad Adnan
arxiv-2403-09054.description: Abstract Transformers have emerged as the underpinning architecture for Large Language Models (LLMs). In generative language models, the inference process involves two primary phases: prompt processing and token generation. Token generation, which constitutes the majority of the computational workload, primarily entails vector-matrix multiplications and interactions with the Key-Value ( 𝖪𝖵 \mathsf{KV} ) Cache.

arxiv-2403-15006.title: Lecture notes on stationary critical and super-critical SPDEs Notes for the lecture series “Large-scale behavior of (super)-critical stochastic PDEs” by F. Toninelli, CIME summer school “Statistical Mechanics and Stochastic PDEs”, Cetraro (Italy), 2023
arxiv-2403-15006.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . The goal of these lecture notes is to present recent results regarding the large-scale behaviour of critical and super-critical non-linear stochastic PDEs, that fall outside the realm of the theory of Regularity Structures. These include the two-dimensional Anisotropic KPZ equation, the stochastic Burgers equation in dimension d ≥ 2 d\geq 2 and the stochastic Navier-Stokes equation with divergence-free noise in dimension d = 2 d=2 .

arxiv-2411-00962.title: Not So Flat Metrics
arxiv-2411-00962.creator: Cristofero S. Fraser-Taliente, Thomas R. Harvey, Manki Kim
arxiv-2411-00962.description: Abstract In order to be in control of the α ′ \alpha^{\prime} derivative expansion, geometric string compactifications are understood in the context of a large volume approximation. In this letter, we consider the reduction of these higher derivative terms, and propose an improved estimate on the large volume approximation using numerical Calabi-Yau metrics obtained via machine learning methods.

arxiv-2502-01779.title: Anisotropic cosmology in q q -deformed entropic gravity
arxiv-2502-01779.creator: Salih Kibaroğlu 1, Mustafa Senay 2
arxiv-2502-01779.description: Abstract In this work, we examine the implications of q q -deformed theory on anisotropic Bianchi type-I cosmological model within the framework of Verlinde’s entropic gravity. The q q -deformed theory, rooted in quantum group structures, provides a natural generalization of classical particle dynamics and offers a useful framework for exploring deviations in standard cosmological models.

arxiv-2509-01343.title: The nuclear surface diffuseness effects on the alpha decay of heavy and super heavy nuclei
arxiv-2509-01343.creator: S. Mohammadi 1, R. Gharaei 2, S. A. Alavi 1
arxiv-2509-01343.description: Abstract The present study aims at investigating systematically the effects of nuclear surface diffuseness on the alpha decay within the framework of the Coulomb and proximity potential model along with the WKB approximation. We select 300 different parent nuclei in the range Z = 64 − 106 Z=64-106 .

arxiv-2510-01734.title: Stabilizing Thompson Sampling with Point Null Bayesian Response-Adaptive Randomization
arxiv-2510-01734.creator: Samuel Pawel, Leonhard Held
arxiv-2510-01734.description: Abstract Response-adaptive randomization (RAR) methods use accumulated data to adapt randomization probabilities, aiming to increase the probability of allocating patients to effective treatments. A popular RAR method is Thompson sampling, which randomizes patients proportionally to the Bayesian posterior probability that each treatment is the most effective.

arxiv-2510-04405.title: Dyonic RN-like and Taub-NUT-like black holes in Einstein-bumblebee gravity
arxiv-2510-04405.creator: Shoulong Li, Liang Liang, Liang Ma
arxiv-2510-04405.description: Abstract Einstein-bumblebee gravity is one of the simplest vector-tensor theories that realizes spontaneous Lorentz symmetry breaking. In this work, we first construct an exact dyonic Reissner-Nordström-like black hole solution in four dimensions, carrying both electric and magnetic charges and admitting general topological horizons.

arxiv-2510-05693.title: Exploring Quantum Spacetime with Topological Data Analysis
arxiv-2510-05693.creator: J. van der Duin, R. Loll, M. Schiffer, A. Silva
arxiv-2510-05693.description: Abstract In a novel application of the tools of topological data analysis (TDA) to nonperturbative quantum gravity, we introduce a new class of observables that allows us to assess whether quantum spacetime really resembles a “quantum foam” near the Planck scale.

arxiv-2601-20253.title: Automated Benchmark Generation from Domain Guidelines Informed by Bloom’s Taxonomy
arxiv-2601-20253.creator: Si Chen, Le Huy Khiem, Annalisa Szymanski, Ronald Metoyer, Ting Hua, Nitesh V. Chawla
arxiv-2601-20253.description: Abstract Open-ended question answering (QA) evaluates a model’s ability to perform contextualized reasoning beyond factual recall. This challenge is especially acute in practice-based domains, where knowledge is procedural and grounded in professional judgment, while most existing LLM benchmarks depend on pre-existing human exam datasets that are often unavailable in such settings.

arxiv-2602-07143.title: Massive Sound Embedding Benchmark (MSEB)
arxiv-2602-07143.creator: Georg Heigold, Ehsan Variani, Tom Bagby, Cyril Allauzen, Ji Ma, Shankar Kumar, Michael Riley
arxiv-2602-07143.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Georg Heigold, Ehsan Variani, Tom Bagby, Cyril Allauzen, Ji Ma, Shankar Kumar, Michael Riley. Audio is a critical component of multimodal perception, and any truly intelligent system must demonstrate a wide range of auditory capabilities. These capabilities include transcription, classification, retrieval, reasoning, segmentation, clustering, reranking, and reconstruction.

arxiv-2603-13767.creator: Yikang Ouyang, Yang Luo, Dongsheng Zuo, Yuzhe Ma

pmc-10601154.title: Antimicrobial resistance profiles of salmonella spp. and escherichia coli isolated from fresh nile tilapia (oreochromis niloticus) fish marketed for human consumption
pmc-10601154.creator: Millicent T. Mumbo, Evans N. Nyaboga, Johnson K. Kinyua, Edward K. Muge, Scholastica G. K. Mathenge, Henry Rotich, Geoffrey Muriira, Bernard Njiraini, Joshua M. Njiru
pmc-10601154.description: BackgroundSalmonella spp. and pathogenic strains of Escherichia coli are among the major foodborne zoonotic pathogens. These bacterial pathogens cause human illnesses characterized by hemorrhagic colitis, vomiting, nausea, and other agent-related symptoms. The increasing occurrence of antimicrobial resistance in these pathogens is also a serious public health concern globally. Regular surveillance of phenotypes and genotypes of Salmonella spp.

pmc-11456553.title: The effects of herding and dispersal behaviour on the evolution of cooperation on complete networks
pmc-11456553.creator: Hasan Haq, Pedro H. T. Schimit, Mark Broom
pmc-11456553.description: Evolutionary graph theory has considerably advanced the process of modelling the evolution of structured populations, which models the interactions between individuals as pairwise contests. In recent years, these classical evolution models have been extended to incorporate more realistic features, e.g. multiplayer games.

pmc-12008324.title: Genetic Polymorphisms of DNA Repair Genes and their Influence on Paclitaxel based Chemotherapy Induced Toxicity Reactions in Breast Cancer Patients
pmc-12008324.creator: Kailas D Datkhile, Prajakta N Reur, Shivani R Kale, Rashmi A Gudur, Suresh J Bhosale, Anand K Gudur
pmc-12008324.description: Background:Systemic chemotherapy constitutes an indispensable component of breast cancer (BC) management, where therapeutic drug combinations such as anthracyclines, platinum compounds, and taxanes form the cornerstone of standard treatment protocols. Although DNA repair genes are pivotal in cancer susceptibility, their specific roles in mediating acute or chronic toxicity outcomes induced by chemotherapy remain undetermined.

pmc-12647644.title: JAVEMACS-D: claims database analysis of avelumab maintenance therapy for advanced urothelial carcinoma in Japan
pmc-12647644.creator: Takashi Kobayashi, Hiroshi Kitamura, Yuka Furukawa, Michihiro Shono, Takayuki Ito, Eiji Kikuchi
pmc-12647644.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). JAVEMACS-D was an observational, retrospective study describing real-world characteristics, treatment patterns, and outcomes in patients with advanced urothelial carcinoma (aUC) treated with avelumab maintenance after first-line platinum-based chemotherapy (PBC) in Japan using a large claims database (Medical Data Vision). Between February 2021 and April 2023, 773 patients received avelumab maintenance; median age was 74 years, primary tumor site was bladder in 59.9% and renal pelvis/ureter in 42.7%, and first-line PBC was cisplatin-gemcitabine in 61.3% and carboplatin-gemcitabine in 36.4%.

pmc-13147110.title: Longitudinal changes and predictors of happiness in South Korean early adolescents: a panel study using latent growth modeling
pmc-13147110.creator: Hyesun Jeong, Mi-Ae You, Yoonju Lee
pmc-13147110.description: PurposeEarly adolescence is a pivotal developmental stage characterized by rapid physical, emotional, and social changes. Happiness during this period is crucial as it influences later life outcomes. This study examined 4-year changes in happiness and identified predictors among Korean early adolescents.

pmc-13188285.title: Effects of heat-assisted sample desiccation on microbiome surveys
pmc-13188285.creator: Claire E. Mullin, Stilianos Louca
pmc-13188285.description: Sample preservation remains a challenge in microbiome surveys, particularly in remote areas. Drying samples eliminates the need for cold chains and preservatives, but sophisticated desiccation tools such as lyophilization are impractical in the field. Further, the effects of sample drying on modern analyses, such as gene-centric metagenomics and metagenome-assembled genome (MAG) recovery, remain poorly understood.

pmc-13220974.title: Disrupting Motor Cortical Regional Activity during Motor Sequence Skill Training Impairs Human Motor Visuomotor Skill Acquisition and Learning That Is Not Sequence-Specific
pmc-13220974.creator: Iran Gutierrez, Oindrila Sinha, Nathan Baune, Jasmine Mirdamadi, Michael Borich
pmc-13220974.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Implicit sequence and visuomotor skill learning is important for successful goal-directed behavior in everyday tasks. However, prior research has primarily relied on correlational methods to investigate the underlying neural mechanisms of sequence and visuomotor skill learning.

pmc-13267786.title: 900 patients evaluated within a median of 1 day from referral in a very early arthritis clinic in France
pmc-13267786.creator: Esther Ebstein, Pierre-Antoine Juge, Marine Forien, Leslie Benattar, Marie Péan de Ponfilly, Madeleine Franc, Bastien Léger, Anne Dupont, Manon Lemee, Chloé Jessen, Margaux Moret, Léa Bastard, Laurinda Carré, Sirine Mahjoub, Monika Klimek, Anna Molto, Marie-Christine Gallais, Mylène Dousset, Sébasti
pmc-13267786.description: ObjectiveIn order to fit with National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) guidelines on arthritis, we established a ‘very early arthritis clinic’ (v-EAC) to evaluate patients within 48 h of a medical referral for any suspected arthritis of <1-month duration. We describe the characteristics of patients referred to the v-EAC from 2 October 2023 to 1 October 2024.

pmc-13494557.title: Ontogenetic Change in Performance: Do Innovations Constrain Performance in Gobiid Fishes?
pmc-13494557.creator: H L Schoenfuss, K M Diamond, R Lagarde, R W Blob
pmc-13494557.description: SynopsisRecent innovations in a species may expand opportunities to obtain new resources or previously inaccessible habitats. Over time, the novel behavior may diversify in response to an adaptive landscape or become canalized by convergent selective pressures into a narrowed performance window. Selective pressures also change across life stages, which may further enhance diversification or constrain performance.

pmc-13609540.title: The Tol-Pal System Promotes Pseudoiodinine Production by Enhancing Bacterial Growth in Pseudomonas mosselii
pmc-13609540.creator: Ruihuan Yang, Xiangning Du, Heng Zhang, Jiacan Yang, Zhuoyi Huang, Ning Xu, Lifang Zou, Gongyou Chen
pmc-13609540.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Pseudoiodinine is an antimicrobial compound produced by Pseudomonas mosselii that exhibits strong inhibitory activity against bacterial and fungal pathogens of rice, highlighting its potential as a green biopesticide. However, the regulatory mechanisms underlying pseudoiodinine production remain poorly understood. In this study, genome-wide random mutagenesis identified two insertion mutants of 277-3 and 277-23 that completely abolished antagonistic activity against Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzicola (Xoc) RS105, with transposon insertions mapped to tolB and tolR, respectively.
